description: Nestled in an iconic neighborhood with timeless Parisian charm, this loft is a true hidden gem. Sheltered from the bustle of the city, it offers a unique and warm setting. The apartment features 4 bedrooms, including two in a lower level, all with ample storage and private bathrooms. Recently renovated to a high standard, it boasts generous, light-filled spaces thanks to carefully designed lighting. The spacious and inviting living room with open kitchen is perfect for gathering together.The spaceThe 1500 sqft apartment is located on the ground floor of a typical Marais building.Designed and tastefully decorated by a renowned interior architect, the apartment features adjustable lighting and individual temperature control in each room, ensuring year-round comfort thanks to underfloor heating and air conditioning. With only one street-facing window and a window onto the courtyard, the apartment offers a peaceful, cocoon-like atmosphere. The generous ceiling height, glass roof above the living room, well-designed lighting and efficient ventilation ensure the space feels open, comfortable and never enclosed.The dining area includes a table that comfortably seats up to 10 guests.The fully equipped kitchen offers a dishwasher, oven and microwave, induction cooktop, kettle, Nespresso coffee machine with capsules, toaster, as well as a washing machine and a dryer. An ironing board, iron and drying rack are also provided.The living room sofa bed converts into a comfortable 180x200 cm sleeping area with a 12 cm thick mattress. Bed linen and duvets for this bed are stored in the wardrobe of one of the bedrooms.The first air-conditioned bedroom features a hotel-quality queen-size bed (160x200 cm), a spacious wardrobe and a dedicated workspace with a desk.
